name: Coral bleaching
summary: No global bleaching event in progress; El Niño heat stress building in the Caribbean
state: The fourth global coral bleaching event was declared over in June 2026. A regional bulletin in August forecast basin-wide Caribbean heat stress at Alert Level 1 by November, and researchers warn the strong El Niño could bring a fifth global event (GCRMN; CORDAP). No new regional mass bleaching had been confirmed as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Reef-dependent fisheries and tourism in the Caribbean are the most exposed if heat stress turns into mass bleaching over the coming months.
rubric_hit: No global bleaching event or confirmed regional mass bleaching in progress (Normal)

sources.title: GCRMN — Heat stress builds across the northern Caribbean
CORDAP — Will the El Niño bring a fifth global coral bleaching event?

why: Reefs support a quarter of marine species and coastal economies; mass bleaching is a direct sign of ocean heat stress.
drivers: Marine heatwaves, El Niño, warming trend.

rubric.alert: Bleaching extent at record levels with active new alerts in the past month.
rubric.watch: Global bleaching event in progress, or regional mass bleaching.
rubric.normal: No global bleaching event in progress.
